evidence.completionSnapshot: Read from each Sprint's closing record ({{recorded}} recorded, {{reconstructed}} reconstructed from status history)
evidence.dodVerifications: Read from {{verified}} recorded Definition of Done verifications
evidence.impedimentRegister: Read from the team's impediment register ({{total}} recorded in total)
evidence.sprintBacklogChanges: Read from {{changes}} recorded Sprint Backlog changes
evidence.sprintGoalVerdict: The Scrum Team's own verdict, recorded at the Sprint Review ({{assessed}} of {{sprintCount}} Sprints assessed)
evidence.sprintHistory: Read from the record of {{sprintCount}} closed Sprints

adaptation.description: Bring these signals to the Sprint Retrospective and turn the ones that matter into improvements for the next Sprint.
adaptation.title: Inspect and adapt

completedPointsHistory.description: Across the last {{sprintCount}} observed Sprints the team completed {{average}} points on average, ranging from {{min}} to {{max}}. This is what happened, not a target, and it is not comparable with another team.
completedPointsHistory.title: Completed points history

definitionOfDone.description: {{compliancePercentage}}% of the Definition of Done criteria verified on the items of the observed Sprints were met ({{verified}} verifications).
definitionOfDone.title: Definition of Done

openImpediments.description: {{openCount}} impediments are open; {{atRiskCount}} have been unresolved for longer than a Sprint, and the oldest has been open {{oldestAgeDays}} days.
openImpediments.title: Open impediments

sprintBacklogChurn.description: The Sprint Backlog changed {{changes}} times during the observed Sprints; {{endangeringGoal}} of those changes were declared as endangering the Sprint Goal, and {{awaitingAcknowledgement}} are still awaiting the Product Owner's acknowledgement.
sprintBacklogChurn.title: Sprint Backlog changes

sprintBacklogCompletion.description: {{delivered}} of {{sprintCount}} observed Sprints delivered all of the points they planned. A Sprint can deliver every planned point without meeting its Sprint Goal, and meet its Sprint Goal without delivering every point.
sprintBacklogCompletion.title: Sprint Backlog completion

sprintGoalVerdicts.description: The team recorded a Sprint Goal verdict on {{assessed}} of {{sprintCount}} Sprints: {{achieved}} achieved, {{partiallyAchieved}} partially achieved, {{notAchieved}} not achieved.
sprintGoalVerdicts.noneRecorded: No Sprint Goal verdict has been recorded yet. The Sprint Review is where the team assesses how far the Sprint Goal was met.
sprintGoalVerdicts.title: Sprint Goal assessment
